title: Pixel Pro 6 Android 12 no longer connects to Dash
symptom: On Pixel Pro 6 with Android 12, after updating AndroidAPS, the app no longer connects to the Dash pod. The issue starts with a BT connection permission issue. In-session updates do not work, but a clean install and activating a new pod works.
cause: The issue is related to a Bluetooth connection permission that is requested during pod activation. In-session updates do not prompt for this permission, so the connection fails. The problem was fixed in a later dev version (dev 18) which prompts for the permission.
fix: Update to AndroidAPS dev 18 (or later) which prompts for the required Bluetooth permission and allows connection to the Dash pod. Alternatively, perform a clean install and activate a new pod to grant the permission.
evidence_quote: It seems most recent commits for Dev 18 has fixed this. not sure if each new version will prompt a new BT permission but it forced me to request that permission and then connected to Dash pod.
